_comment: Sourced decision rules for municipal contests, keyed by lowercased city name: { "rule": "majority" | "plurality", "source": "<charter or ordinance citation and URL>" }. A city not listed stays `unknown` and shows "Runoff rule unverified" instead of a runoff badge (src/lib/elections/close-races/rules.ts). Add a city only with a cited source.

doraville.source: No plurality provision: DeKalb VRE sent Doraville City Council District 1, Post 2 (Yeoman 41.08%) to the Dec 3, 2024 runoff under O.C.G.A. § 21-2-501. https://dekalbcountyga.gov/news/dekalb-county-voter-registration-and-elections-announces-generalspecial-election-runoff
